title: LiveNerf 的重复采样设计
summary: 作者解释 Opus 5.5 监测方法：从 2,336 道题筛出 78 道有区分度的题，按十日窗口比较，并要求连续窗口达到预设置信门槛；不是模型已退化的结论。
summary_en: The author describes selecting 78 variable questions from 2,336 for daily Opus 5.5 monitoring, comparing ten-day windows against preregistered thresholds. This explains methodology, not proof of degradation.
author: ninjahawk1
evidenceBasis: original story/comment via Algolia; author-reported, not independently reproduced

title: 单文件 Mini React 界面库
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 测试开发轻量 React 风格界面库，包含虚拟 DOM、键控差异更新、hooks、context 和 memo；声称压缩后约 3.5 KB，无依赖。
summary_en: The author tests Opus 5.5 by building a small React-like library with a virtual DOM, keyed diffing, hooks, context and memo, reporting about 3.5 KB gzipped without dependencies.
author: bepero
evidenceBasis: original story/comment via Algolia; author-reported, not independently reproduced

title: Matrix 家庭助手的连续记忆
title_en: A Matrix family assistant with continuity
summary: Silta 在 Matrix 上提供问答、网页研究 PDF 与定时任务，通过自写交接摘要保持跨上下文连续性；作者报告改用 Opus 5.5 后可在 Pro 订阅中运行。
summary_en: Silta provides questions, web-research PDFs and scheduled tasks through Matrix, carrying context forward with custom handoff summaries. The author reports running it on a Pro subscription after switching to Opus 5.5.
author: dmitry-markin
evidenceBasis: original story/comment via Algolia; author-reported, not independently reproduced

title: 个人网站的字体、主题与阅读动画
title_en: Fonts, themes and reading animations for a personal site
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 实现字体选择、阅读栏动画和主题，并修复导航高亮；也记录它会扩改需求，曾花两小时修复自己引入的索引错误。
summary_en: The author uses Opus 5.5 for a font picker, animated reading column and themes, while reporting scope expansion and a navigation bug that took two hours to repair.
author: marquix
evidenceBasis: original story/comment via Algolia; author-reported, not independently reproduced

title: 用逆向分析技能查找老游戏漏洞
title_en: Finding old-game bugs with a reverse-engineering skill
summary: 作者为游戏逆向与缺陷排查编写技能，并报告 Opus 5.5 找到了 Commodore 64《Mercenary》中的一个问题，附公开代码线索；未独立复现。
summary_en: The author builds a reverse-engineering skill and reports that Opus 5.5 found a bug in the Commodore 64 game Mercenary, linking public code. The finding was not reproduced.
author: a1r
evidenceBasis: original story/comment via Algolia; author-reported, not independently reproduced
